info.name: Payment Processing Service
info.description: Automated checks of the payments API, organized by user story (docs/02-user-stories.md). Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner or Newman: the first request prepares a unique run id, and later requests reuse ids saved by earlier ones. Requires the stack running (docker compose up -d) at {{baseUrl}}.

exec: // Every response, including errors, carries the correlation id (HU-10).

request.description: Health check of the API through the gateway; also prepares the variables of the run.

exec: // Unique per run, so the idempotency keys and merchants never collide with earlier runs.

item.name: HU-01 Enviar un pago
item.description: Creates a payment and checks the creation response.

exec: pm.test('only exposes the brand and the last four digits', () => pm.expect(payment.card).to.eql({ brand: 'VISA', last4: '1111' }));

item.name: HU-02 Rechazar datos de entrada inválidos
item.description: Invalid input answers 422 VALIDATION_ERROR and creates nothing.

item.name: HU-03 Aplicar reglas de negocio
item.description: Business rules decline before calling the acquirer; the response is still 201.

item.name: CLP at the limit is approved
CLP above the limit is declined
USD with cents keeps the amount

exec: pm.test('returns the amount in cents', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({ amount: 1050, currency: 'USD' }));

item.name: USD at the limit is approved
USD above the limit is declined
Card that fails Luhn is declined
Card that expired last month is declined
Card that expires this month is approved
HU-04 Respetar la decisión del adquirente
item.description: A decline from the acquirer is final.

item.name: HU-05 Tolerar errores temporales del adquirente
item.description: Temporary errors are retried up to 3 attempts.

item.name: Fails as ACQUIRER_UNAVAILABLE after three errors
Same key and content replays the original
Same key for another merchant creates a new payment

exec: pm.test('has the same fields as the creation response', () => Object.keys(created).forEach((field) => pm.expect(detail[field]).to.eql(created[field])));

item.name: HU-08 Listar transacciones
item.description: Filters, order and paging over the payments created by this run.

exec: pm.test('only lists declined payments of the merchant', () => page.data.forEach((t) => pm.expect(t).to.include({ merchant_id: `merchant-${pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')}`, status: 'DECLINED' })));
pm.test('finds the declined payments of this run', () => pm.expect(page.meta.total).to.be.at.least(5));
pm.test('is ordered from newest to oldest', () => pm.expect(dates).to.eql([...dates].sort().reverse()));

item.name: HU-09 Trazar el historial de la transacción
item.description: The history of the payment that needed a retry.

exec: pm.test('has the five events in order', () => pm.expect(events.map((e) => [e.type, e.from_status, e.to_status, e.metadata && e.metadata.outcome])).to.eql([
pm.test('records the error of the failed attempt', () => pm.expect(events[2].metadata).to.include({ attempt: 1, error_code: 'HTTP_503' }));
pm.test('every event has the correlation id of the request', () => events.forEach((e) => pm.expect(e.correlation_id).to.eql(`corr-retry-${pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')}`)));

item.name: HU-10 Correlacionar logs y eventos
item.description: The correlation id travels with the request.

item.name: Generates a UUID when none is sent
Errors carry the correlation id too

exec: pm.test('returns the correlation id on errors', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Correlation-Id')).to.eql(`corr-error-${pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')}`));

item.name: HU-11 Proteger los datos de tarjeta
item.description: The full card number and the CVV never come back.

item.name: Response without the card number or CVV

exec: pm.test('does not return the full card number', () => pm.expect(text).to.not.include('4111111111111111'));
pm.test('does not return the CVV', () => { pm.expect(text).to.not.include('"987"'); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('cvv'); });
